_comment: Logical quarantine: exclusions keyed by carrier ID + relative member path + payload SHA-256, per OP-PROT-019 §6. Frozen bytes and old manifests stay intact; the affected certification claim is excluded from active consumption. Restoration needs a new erratum/successor and a fresh review. Transcribed from registers/json/quarantine_index.json (GP-REG-032-v1.2, 2026-09-17); payload hashes resolved from drive/source_map/Archive_Members.csv.
